_comment: Budgets for the LAB (Lighthouse simulated mobile, 4x CPU, slow 4G, cold cache, production build via `next start`). They are NOT field budgets: field p75 from Vercel Speed Insights is the source of truth. See docs/PERFORMANCE.md for derivation. Raise a value only in a PR that includes measured justification.

measuredOn.commits: 9030df7, 9ed239b, de04365 (bench/*.json, 3-7 runs each) and seo-* runs on 421a98d (3 runs each)
measuredOn.hardware: Apple M1 Pro, Chrome 154, Lighthouse 13.5, Node 22
measuredOn.merged-build-measurement: Homepage first-load JS measured 191151 gzip bytes on 48f4d43 (200572 before the server-component refactor); homepage total transfer ~218 KB incl. images served via next/image. Static JS budget = measured + ~5%; lab image budget replaces a figure derived from the old 1.4 MB CSS-background image.
measuredOn.caveat: GitHub-hosted runners are slower and noisier than the M1 used to measure; LHCI uses the median of 5 runs and headroom of 20-30%.

static._comment: Checked by scripts/check-budgets.mjs from the .next build output, no browser. Sizes are gzip bytes of files referenced by the prerendered homepage HTML.
static._comment_v1: Dual-site: the budgets above apply to BOTH the V1 homepage (/) and the V2 homepage (/2), measured per page. v1BaselineJsGzipBytes is the V1 homepage first-load JS measured on `main` (single-site build, 192857); V1 may exceed it by at most v1BaselineToleranceBytes.

lab._comment: Enforced by lighthouserc.json. Units: ms, score 0-1, KiB-as-bytes where noted.

fieldOnly.INP: Not measurable in lab Lighthouse. Track p75 in Vercel Speed Insights; target <= 200 ms (Google 'good').
